replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.1 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original goblin Flare course')
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x3b526));assert(target and target:isValid(),'Original goblin missing')
 print(string.format('FlareGoblin stats health=%.4f magicka=%.4f targetHealth=%.4f dead=%s pos=%s',Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current,Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current,Actor.stats.dynamic.health(target).current,tostring(Actor.isDead(target)),tostring(self.position)))
 if Actor.isDead(target) then print('FlareGoblin victory');return end
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 local aim=target.position+util.vector3(0,0,100)
 local v=aim-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 local c=aim-camera.getPosition();local pitch=-math.atan2(c.z,math.sqrt(c.x*c.x+c.y*c.y))
 if math.abs(angle)<.025 and math.abs(pitch-camera.getPitch())<.025 then print('FlareGoblin ready') end
 print(string.format('FlareGoblin aim x=%d y=%d distance=%.2f',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*256+.5))),v:length()))
end}}}}
